children: Piedmont Realty Trust priced a $200,000,000 offering of 2.875% exchangeable senior notes due 2031 and will fully guarantee the notes.
Offered $200,000,000 aggregate principal of 2.875% exchangeable senior notes due 2031 in a Rule 144A private placement.
Piedmont will fully and unconditionally guarantee the notes on a senior, unsecured basis; settlement expected Sept 17, 2026.
Initial exchange rate 79.0514 shares per $1,000 principal (initial exchange price $12.65), ~37.5% premium to $9.20 close.
Initial purchasers have a 13-day option to buy an additional $30,000,000 of notes, potentially increasing proceeds to ~$223.5M.
Estimated net proceeds ~$194.3M (or ~$223.5M if option exercised); intends to redeem outstanding 9.250% notes due 2028 and repurchase ~5.43M shares for ~$50M.
